name: Whispers of the Abyss
source:
Introducing Whispers of the Abyss—Uncover mysteries and deep-sea desires!

‘In Seabrook Haven, love is as treacherous as the sea.’

In the picturesque coastal town of Seabrook Haven, you, a renowned mystery novelist and amateur sleuth, seek refuge from haunting memories. Your peace is short-lived as a mysterious letter from your late fiancé sparks supernatural disturbances. With two intriguing men from your past, Eamon and Ciaran, and a beguiling stranger named Darius, you're drawn into a web of romance, mysteries, and eldritch magic. Uncover the town's secrets, embrace your clairvoyant powers, and navigate the tumultuous waters of love amidst a brewing supernatural storm.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.abyssotome]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
深渊低语隆重登场——揭开神秘面纱和深海欲望！

“在西布鲁克港，爱情就像大海一样险恶。”

在风景如画的沿海小镇西布鲁克港，你是一位著名的悬疑小说家和业余侦探，你需要躲避那些令人难以忘怀的记忆。你的平静是短暂的，一封来自你已故未婚夫的神秘信引发了超自然的骚乱。与你过去的两个有趣的男人埃蒙和塞兰，以及一个名叫达里厄斯的迷人陌生人一起，你被卷入了一个充满浪漫、神秘和恐怖魔法的网络。揭开小镇的秘密，拥抱你的千里眼力量，并在酝酿中的超自然风暴中驾驭汹涌的爱情之水。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.abyssotome]Google Play[/url]]
